children: According to SoSoValue data, SOL spot ETFs recorded a net inflow of $10.3048 million during the trading days from September 7 to September 11, U.S. Eastern Time. According to Odaily, Bitwise ETF BSOL led weekly inflows with $9.5259 million, bringing its cumulative net inflow to $1.03 billion, while Fidelity ETF FSOL saw $888,400 in weekly inflows and $214 million in cumulative net inflows. Grayscale's SOL trust GSOL posted the largest weekly outflow at $1.1705 million, though its cumulative net inflow still stood at $134 million. As of press time, SOL spot ETFs held net assets of $1.42 billion, with an ETF net asset ratio of 2.36% of SOL's total market value and cumulative net inflows of $1.36 billion.

title: SOL Spot ETFs Record $10.3 Million Net Inflow Last Week
